cases.given: /input/A/nested/photo.jpg imported at /input/A; chosen /deliver; retain hierarchy
cases.expect: /deliver/A/nested/photo.jpg

cases.given: /input/A/nested/photo.jpg; source folder; project Exports
cases.expect: /input/A/nested/Exports/photo.jpg

cases.given: /a/Session and /b/Session imported together
cases.expect: Separate Session-<stable-root-hash> trees; no merged outputs; selection order does not change names

cases.given: original and two virtual copies sharing source path, distinct item IDs and frame receipts
cases.expect: Three distinct targets and preserved recipes; stable item ordering; no source-path keyed collapse

cases.given: target exists and conflict ask
cases.expect: needs_confirmation; task attach refused until user chooses rename or skip inside existing export settings and previews again

cases.given: source target alias or hardlink, rename policy
cases.expect: Original inode unchanged; new unique name; no overwrite even if file appears after preview

cases.given: ../ traversal, absolute target filename, NUL, backslash or >255-byte component
cases.expect: Rejected before directory creation or rendering

cases.given: output ancestor symlink, dangling target symlink, source escaping import root
cases.expect: Ancestor/source escape rejected; existing target never overwritten

cases.given: missing target parents, create_missing false; then true
cases.expect: First preview fails without mkdir; second lists missing parents and only commit creates them

cases.given: read-only directory, inaccessible parent, missing source
cases.expect: Actionable failure, no export or fallback directory

cases.given: intent or frame changes during preview, repeated submit, close/reopen
cases.expect: Stale preview discarded; no duplicate queue submission; re-preview required

cases.given: queue JSON roundtrip and retry with existing target
cases.expect: Identical plan ID and target; fail review-required, never a new auto-numbered target

cases.given: restart with destination plan but missing frozen recipes
cases.expect: Existing recipe_persisted guard blocks retry; plan alone cannot authorize rendering

cases.given: RGB16 TIFF, ICC, GPS false, compression, watermark and layout options
cases.expect: Destination layer retains exact export settings and filename suffix; both writer branches use frozen target; no color/metadata change

cases.given: target raced in after preview or symlink ancestor swapped
cases.expect: No-clobber commit refuses target; descriptor-relative nofollow traversal never follows symlink

cases.given: disk full, fsync or unlink error after link commit
cases.expect: No original changed; queue reports uncertain/failed receipt, retry detects existing target and requires review

cases.given: engine restarted or reply arrives after release
cases.expect: Mailbox cleared; late reply ignored; unsupported capability never falls back to flattening export

cases.given: watermark dual output and layout aggregate filenames
cases.expect: Every derivative reserved in full plan; real RGB8/RGB16 clean outputs and layout pages/PDF/manifest use frozen paths; partial outputs remain in failed receipts

cases.given: add folder A, add folder B, open a photo and rescan
cases.expect: Both explicit import roots remain in library; no flattening or dropped directory

cases.given: v23 save/reopen, create virtual copy, relocate original
cases.expect: Original logical import root/relative path retained for all copies; physical source-folder output uses relocated source directory

cases.given: legacy v23 project without import_origin
cases.expect: Preview visibly identifies legacy parent-directory fallback; no claim of known original hierarchy

cases.given: cancel or navigate away during preview, then receive late result
cases.expect: Result discarded by generation/input fence; no export is submitted; native receipt released

cases.given: cross-directory source-mode layout without layout_root
cases.expect: Preview requires explicit summary destination; never chooses the first image directory silently
